name: XEPTION Network
tagline: Cameroon-focused e-commerce storefront connected to inventory, orders, payments and operational tools for XEPTION.
problem: A live catalogue cannot support a retail operation on its own without consistent stock, fulfillment, local payments and access-controlled staff workflows.
scenario: A customer explores products and places an order through the storefront while authorized staff manage stock, fulfillment and the customer's after-sales process through separate operational roles.
differentiation: The platform connects public browsing and local commerce to a managed backend with separate business processes instead of treating sales and inventory as disconnected spreadsheets.
architecture: React 18/Vite storefront + staff ERP UI -> Supabase Edge Functions and PostgreSQL with access policies -> payments, stock, fulfillment and notifications integrations.
limitations: Public README content must not reveal customer records, supplier prices, production secrets or private staff routing. Mentioned payment gateways require valid configured merchant accounts; no revenue/customer statistics are assumed.
